snippet.title: 🪖 WELTKRIEG 1: FIRESTORM — OPEN BETA
snippet.description:
🔥 OPEN BETA IS HERE — WELTKRIEG 1: FIRESTORM 🔥

🪖 Step into the brutal battlefields of World War I and experience large-scale trench warfare on mobile. Explosions, mud, gas, and chaos — this is war like you’ve never seen before.

📅 Open Beta starts April 16 on Google Play
📌 Download link will be available in the comments on April 16
(no more any forms to fill out, just download and play for free ❤️🔥)
Official SOCIAL MEDIA:
https://linktr.ee/Bixteam
DOWNLOAD:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.bixteam.weltkrieg1firestorm&pcampaignid=web_share
⚔️ WHAT TO EXPECT:
Battle of Passchendaele, Somme, Messines Operation maps,
Intense WWI trench combat
Authentic weapons and equipment
Large-scale operations and dynamic battles
Tactical gameplay focused on teamwork
💥 Push the front line, survive the chaos, and become a true soldier of the Great War.

👀 Stay tuned and don’t miss the release!

Follow us for updates, news, and future events.
